findings.detail: a symbol carrying two ISINs is two companies in one series

findings.check: one ISIN trades under one symbol on any given day
findings.detail: two symbols sharing an ISIN on the same day is a merge error, not a rename -- a rename is sequential and this is not

note: A rename (one ISIN, several symbols) is normal and is counted, not failed. Ticker reuse (one symbol, several ISINs) is the defect, because it fabricates a continuous history.
